title: Paul McCartney live: Qudos Bank Arena, Sydney | 2017
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Qudos Bank Arena in Sydney, Australia, on 11 December 2017.

It was the 75th show of the One On One Tour, which lasted for 77 dates between April 2016 and December 2017, and the first of two consecutive nights in Sydney.

We’ve been waiting to get back to Australia and New Zealand for years and now it’s finally happening. It is very exciting. I’m really looking forward to the concerts as we’ve always had such a brilliant time whenever we’ve been before so we know we are in for a treat. Can’t wait to see you and all rock out together.
Paul McCartney
paulmccartney.com

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums). They were joined by the Governor Macquarie Memorial Pipe Band for ‘Mull Of Kintyre’.

Rocking with Kyles in Syd ??#oneonone pic.twitter.com/5Vpd0ZnZC6

— Paul McCartney (@PaulMcCartney) December 11, 2017
